name: local-ai-factory
guidance: Web builds run in supported browsers on each device; backend and recipient account required. No native Apple or Windows installer is configured.

web.notice: Browser assets, not a native installer. Host with authenticated recipient access over HTTPS; do not copy owner credentials or data.
